preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 40 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**4 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of ingredients N is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 10**9 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the maximum amount K of each ingredient is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(g) == N for (N, K), g in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N integers, where N is the number of ingredients for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= gi <= K for gi in g) for (N, K), g in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each ingredient amount gi in the output is between 1 and K inclusive for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(taste == (lambda g: eval('^'.join(map(str, g))))(g) for (N, K), g in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: The taste of the cake is computed as the bitwise XOR of the amounts of all ingredients for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(taste == max((eval('^'.join(map(str, g))) for g in product(range(1, K+1), repeat=N))) for (N, K), g in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: The taste of the cake is the maximum possible taste for the corresponding test case.
